Title: OpenAI: APIs and tools for building AI products | Product Hunt
## APIs and tools for building AI products. The most powerful platform for building AI products. Build and scale AI experiences powered by industry-leading models and tools. This is the 52nd launch from OpenAI. ## GPT-6 Sol and and Luna. Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price. GPT-6 Sol and Luna are fast, cost-efficient AI models for professional work, coding, computer use, and long-running agents. Built with advances from GPT-6 Astra, they deliver stronger factual accuracy and clearer collaboration while API prices are 50% lower than GPT-5.6. Choose Sol for demanding tasks and Luna for high-volume, everyday AI workloads. GPT-6 Sol & LunaFrontier AI intelligence, now at half the price. OpenAI Agents APICloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness. GPT-6 AstraOpenAI's most capable model for end-to-end work. OpenAI just dropped GPT-5.6, their largest model yet, and we're teaming up with them to get it into makers' hands. - Build something with Sol, Terra, or Luna. - The top products walk away with $10k in OpenAI credits. Over 400 products launched for OpenAI Day. Five walked away with $10K in OpenAI credits, all built on GPT-5.6. I often hear that LinkedIn is starting to be cringe, becoming a second Facebook, but let s be honest: it s still a career platform. On the other hand, Sam Altman introduced a new ambition OpenAI Jobs Platform an AI-powered hiring platform, expected to launch by mid-2026. Reviewers largely see OpenAI as strong, practical, and easy to build with: they praise fast, reliable APIs, solid documentation, and models that handle coding, writing, reasoning, image work, and structured outputs well enough for daily workflows. **GPT-6 Sol and Luna** are OpenAI’s new fast, cost-efficient AI models for professional work, coding, computer use, and long-running agents. **GPT-6 Sol and Luna** bring the gains of GPT-6 Astra into two focused models:. * **Sol** for demanding work and. * **Luna** for high-volume, everyday AI workloads. 50% lower API pricing than GPT-5.6 makes advanced AI far more viable for startups, developers, and teams scaling agents. Compared to alternatives, OpenAI feels less like a single model and more like a long-term platform we can confidently build on.
